$Comment: The invitation tour: once in each run of Harvest Feast, invite people to the feast, then tell the
host who's coming. The step counts a talk credit carrying the Qualifier Harvest_Feast_Invitation,
which only the invitation line gives (DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Invitation.json):
that line shows in every other character's conversation while this quest is carried, and each
character can be asked once a day. No Target means whoever the player is talking to. Npc.TurnInId,
from the base, adds the report-back step to the host once enough people are asked.
Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each run of the feast: a run pays it once, a forced or moved run
cannot pay it twice, and a tour left unfinished when the run ends waits for the next one with its
invitations kept. It pays through Harvest_Feast_Invitations_Pay, with favor with the host and
Festival Favor on its own Rewards.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Acrobatics XP for the walk about the temple, waiting to be
collected with the rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a
server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Invitations
